method: Three production candidate-placement trials; strict output checks and sequential same-process alternating whole calls; nonexclusive host.
decision: Do not adopt the launch-width, shared-winner, or paired-ray layouts without a stable whole-call benefit in the measured dominant candidate workload.

trials.name: bvh_candidate_blocks
trials.reason: 64-thread launch alone preserves original10 bodies but the12000-triangle 4128-ray whole trace does not improve.

trials.name: bvh_compact_blocks
trials.reason: The64-entry shared winner version halves shared memory for the added kernels; small-mesh gains do not extend to the dominant large-mesh case.

trials.name: bvh_paired_candidates
trials.reason: Two64-thread ray groups in one128-thread block preserve tested bits but increase resource counts and show no stable large-batch whole-trace benefit.
